source: Hand-authored model-shaped payload (commit 86f79ab, 10 July 2026; revised in d296b42, 9 August 2026); not a model answer. modelRoute "gemini" is the parser's default route label, not the model that wrote it.

derivationStages.statement: The noun Mia enters the derivation.
derivationStages.stageRecord: Lexical selection introduces the proper noun Mia, which projects a noun phrase that will serve as the external argument of the predicate.

derivationStages.statement: The intransitive verb laughed projects a verb phrase.
derivationStages.stageRecord: The unergative verb laughed is selected and projects a verb phrase; its single theta role is assigned to the external argument position, which the noun phrase Mia will occupy.

derivationStages.statement: Tense combines with the verb phrase.
derivationStages.stageRecord: A finite past tense head selects the verb phrase as its complement, projecting the inflectional layer that licenses the subject position of the clause.

derivationStages.statement: The subject occupies the specifier of TP and the clause converges.
derivationStages.stageRecord: The noun phrase Mia merges as the specifier of the tense projection, and the tense head bears an open agreement relation to that subject; the derivation converges with the surface order Mia laughed.
